title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Accounting Paper 1
description: A practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC A-Level Accounting Paper 1: 40 multiple-choice questions, 40 marks, 1 hour 20 minutes. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** 40 questions. You have 1 hour 20 minutes.

- Each question is worth 1 mark. Choose the one best answer.

Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC A-Level Accounting Paper 2
description: A practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC A-Level Accounting Paper 2: four compulsory 25-mark structured questions (three financial, one cost and management), 100 marks, 1 hour 45 minutes. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** four questions. You have 1 hour 45 minutes. A calculator may be used.

- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

Question sizes and part splits are our convention; real papers vary. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
